Playwright's `fps` option sets a recording's frame rate, and rejects one that isn't positive (SC-010). Strider's video has no frame rate to request: it is variable-rate, with each source frame's time

Playwright's `recordVideo` context option starts a recording automatically and writes it to `recordVideo.dir`, alongside a manual screencast. Strider has no automatic recording: a recording is a capability the caller acquires in a scope (`Capability.Video`), so there is no option whose coexistence with another recording the test could check. VI-002 has the same shape

Playwright's `screencast.stop()` is a method that ends the running screencast, and does nothing when none runs. Strider has no stop method: a screencast or recording ends when its scope closes, and there is no call to make when nothing is running
